provider: CityUHK Architecture and Civil Engineering current normative curricula
academicYear: GE Semester A 2026/27; Major Semester A 2027/28; normative four-year degree
note: The official admissions page states that JS1201 students enter the Department of Architecture and Civil Engineering and choose or are allocated after Year 1 among Architectural Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Architecture and Surveying. The three current normative Catalogue pages each publish a 121-credit graduation structure, 31 GE credits, 6 College credits and 84 Major credits. This supplement exposes 41, 55 and 64 unique stable codes respectively, while preserving Civil Engineering Streams and the Architecture/Surveying Streams as roles inside their official Major rather than separate Majors. Open GE distributional pools, alternative mathematics, Stream selections, professional-accreditation top-ups and cross-group choices are not fully closed by the local rule engine, so all three lists remain browse-only with totalCreditRequired=0.
